Operating System (Introduction)
Operating System (OS) is system software that manages computer hardware and software resources.
subject: System

source.source_text:
Operating System (Introduction)
Operating System (OS) is system software that manages computer hardware and software resources.
Provides an environment for users to run applications.
Acts as an interface between user and hardware.
Hides hardware complexity and manages resources efficiently.
